classes.summary: The Accessibility class extends HPXRebrandingFlow and provides Windows UI automation methods for testing HP application accessibility features. It includes verification methods for Windows overlays, Start menu interactions, app icon visibility on taskbar and Start menu, Microsoft Store operations, and various UI element interactions. The class focuses on ensuring HP applications are properly accessible and integrated within the Windows operating system environment.
